one_time_tokens_new_email_check.name: one_time_tokens_new_email_check
one_time_tokens_new_email_check.value:
("one_time_tokens"."purpose" = 'change_email' and "one_time_tokens"."new_email_enc" is not null and "one_time_tokens"."new_email_blind_index" is not null)
        or ("one_time_tokens"."purpose" <> 'change_email' and "one_time_tokens"."new_email_enc" is null and "one_time_tokens"."new_email_blind_index" is null)

achievements_completion_check.name: achievements_completion_check
achievements_completion_check.value:
("achievements"."status" = 'completed') = ("achievements"."completed_at" is not null)
        and ("achievements"."completed_at" is null) = ("achievements"."execution_score" is null)
        and ("achievements"."completed_at" is null) = ("achievements"."rank" is null)

gambles_settlement_check.name: gambles_settlement_check
gambles_settlement_check.value:
("gambles"."status" = 'pending') = ("gambles"."settled_at" is null)
        and ("gambles"."status" = 'lost') = ("gambles"."loss_reason" is not null)
        and ("gambles"."settled_at" is null or "gambles"."settled_at" >= "gambles"."placed_at")

quests_habit_columns_check.name: quests_habit_columns_check
quests_habit_columns_check.value:
("quests"."type" = 'habit') = ("quests"."habit_period" is not null)
        and ("quests"."type" = 'habit') = ("quests"."habit_times_per_period" is not null)
        and ("quests"."type" = 'habit') = ("quests"."habit_period_count" is not null)
        and ("quests"."type" = 'habit') = ("quests"."habit_start_date" is not null)
        and ("quests"."habit_period" is not distinct from 'week') = ("quests"."habit_week_start" is not null)

quests_target_columns_check.name: quests_target_columns_check
quests_target_columns_check.value:
("quests"."type" = 'target') = ("quests"."start_value_enc" is not null)
        and ("quests"."type" = 'target') = ("quests"."target_value_enc" is not null)
        and ("quests"."type" = 'target' or "quests"."unit_enc" is null)

quests_habit_state_check.name: quests_habit_state_check
quests_habit_state_check.value:
("quests"."type" = 'habit' or ("quests"."reset_count" = 0 and "quests"."habit_best_streak" = 0 and not "quests"."needs_restart"))
        and not ("quests"."needs_restart" and "quests"."completed_at" is not null)

xp_events_amount_check.name: xp_events_amount_check
xp_events_amount_check.value: case when "xp_events"."kind" in ('quest_completed', 'rank_bonus', 'gamble_won', 'xp_floor') then "xp_events"."amount" > 0 else "xp_events"."amount" < 0 end

audit_events_ip_prefix_check.name: audit_events_ip_prefix_check
audit_events_ip_prefix_check.value: masklen("audit_events"."ip_prefix") <= case family("audit_events"."ip_prefix") when 4 then 24 else 48 end
